children: Hyperliquid bought and burned 40,890 HYPE over the past 24 hours at an average price of $58.88 per token. According to Odaily, citing Onchain Lens, the tokens were worth about $2.41 million; cumulative burns have reached 50.89 million HYPE, worth about $3.11 billion, permanently removing 5.09% of the maximum supply. Hyperliquid’s cumulative revenue is $1.44 billion.

title: Hyperliquid Burns 40,890 HYPE in 24 Hours, Cumulative Burn Reaches 5.09% of Maximum Supply
